concept: A fusion of Swiss editorial typography, organic warmth, and tactile interfaces. It blends the intellectual depth of a classic bookstore with the frictionless precision of a modern SaaS.

typography.strategy: Editorial Serif for emotion, Geometric Sans for utility.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold text-charcoal
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-semibold text-charcoal

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than default. p-8 to p-24 for main sections.
layouts.frontend_grid: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical grids for features. gap-8 to gap-12. Never perfectly fill the grid; allow negative space.
layouts.admin_grid: Dense but warm. 3-4 column data layouts. North-star metric top-left. Collapsible left sidebar.
layouts.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header. backdrop-blur-xl + background color at 70% opacity. 1px bottom border. NEVER fully transparent.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + Direct layered shadows. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for standard cards. shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(217,93,57,0.15)] for primary CTA.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders (border-border) on all cards to ground them, paired with soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.radii: Rounded cards (rounded-2xl for surfaces, rounded-full for pills/buttons). Nested radii: child must be smaller than parent.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay on hero sections to kill 'digital flatness'.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses brand color (#D95D39). Hover effect: scale up slightly (scale-105) + shadow increase. MUST explicitly set hover text color.
components.cards: Book/Course Cards: Flat surface, border-border, inner padding p-4 or p-6. Image takes top 60%. Hover: image scale-105 (overflow-hidden).
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized forms. Inputs should have bg-white (or bg-stone-800 in dark mode), ring-primary on focus. Crisp rounded-lg.
components.admin_tables: Clean, flat. No row borders except a subtle bottom border. Text left aligned. Hover row background: surface color.
components.qr_upload_flow: Use a clear step-by-step Bento layout. Step 1: Scan QR (display image clearly). Step 2: Upload File (dashed border dropzone).
components.toasts: Use Sonner for all notifications. Position bottom-right.

motion.transitions: Specific properties only. transition-transform duration-300 ease-out. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for lists (Books/Courses). y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1 over 0.5s.
motion.hover: Micro-interactions on all cards and buttons. Avoid heavy 3D flips, prefer subtle lifts (-translate-y-1).

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., `data-testid="checkout-submit-button"`.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. No light gray text on white. Use deep charcoal or stone for text. Focus rings must be visible (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary`).

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build a hybrid app. E-commerce frontend (Home, Books, Courses, Checkout) + Admin Panel (/admin). Ensure Dark/Light mode toggle works globally.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react. Ensure icons in admin sidebar and frontend features match the premium/minimalist vibe.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for headers and sticky elements, but NEVER fully transparent without a solid base.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations and brand colors.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robot, brain, etc.) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image URLs.
Prioritize using Shadcn components for forms, tables, and dialogs. Use purely custom HTML/Tailwind for marketing/hero layouts.
Apply `data-testid` to all actionable elements (buttons, links, form inputs) to support testing.
